title: Above-Guarantee Algorithm for Properly Colored Trees
summary: In the Properly Colored Spanning Tree problem, we are given an edge-colored undirected graph and the goal is to find a spanning tree in which any two adjacent edges have distinct colors. Since finding such a tree is NP-hard in general, previous work often relied on minimum color degree conditions to guarantee the existence of properly colored spanning trees.
